response.text:
I can’t continuously run in the background or proactively message you after this turn. I’m not able to “check your calendar every morning” or push notifications on my own unless you set up an automation outside this chat or give a separate tool that supports background monitoring. However, I can help in other ways — pick one and I’ll proceed:

1) Create a daily recurring calendar reminder on your calendar (I can create the event now using the calendar connector). This will put a visible reminder on your calendar each morning so you (or whatever notification settings you use) are prompted to check for moved events. If you want this, please confirm these details:
   - Time of day (e.g., 08:00)
   - Time zone
   - Title (default: “Check calendar for moved events”)
   - Start date (default: today) and recurrence (daily, weekdays only, etc.)
   - Notification type and timing (popup x minutes before, email, both)
   - Any attendees to add (none by default)
Once you confirm, I’ll create it.

2) I can give step-by-step instructions to configure event-change notifications or to set up an external automation (Zapier/IFTTT/Power Automate) that will notify you when calendar events are modified. Tell me which calendar service you use (Google Calendar, Outlook/Exchange, etc.) and whether you want email, SMS, or another messaging channel.

3) Manual checks on demand: whenever you message me “check my calendar now”, I can inspect it and report any moved events during that session.

Which option do you want? If you choose option 1, please provide the details above and confirm you want me to create the recurring event.
